# featbit_group_policy_binding (Resource)

Manages one exact FeatBit Group-to-Policy binding through the documented public API. It owns only the configured pair, not either endpoint or the Group's complete Policy collection.

The Policy can be custom or built-in. This resource owns only one exact pair;
it does not own the Group, the Policy, or the Group's complete Policy
collection. If the exact relationship already exists, Create deliberately
adopts that pair into Terraform state without sending another add mutation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "group_name" {
  description = "Organization-scoped, case-sensitive exact Group name."
  type        = string
}

variable "policy_key" {
  description = "Organization-scoped, case-sensitive exact custom or built-in Policy key."
  type        = string
}

data "featbit_group" "target" {
  name = var.group_name
}

data "featbit_policy" "target" {
  key = var.policy_key
}

resource "featbit_group_policy_binding" "example" {
  group_id  = data.featbit_group.target.id
  policy_id = data.featbit_policy.target.id
}
```

## Lifecycle

- Changing either endpoint replaces the binding.
- Read scans the complete Group Policy collection for this exact pair.
- Destroy removes only this pair and preserves every unrelated Group Policy
  relationship.
- Removing the binding never deletes either endpoint. Destroy bindings before
  their managed Group or custom Policy.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Exact Group UUID. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `policy_id` (String) Exact custom or built-in Policy UUID. Changing it replaces the binding.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical synthetic binding ID in `<group_uuid>/<policy_uuid>` form.

## Import

Import one exact Group-Policy pair:

```shell
terraform import featbit_group_policy_binding.example '<group_uuid>/<policy_uuid>'
```

Both components must use canonical 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal UUID form.
